parameters.name: surface_id
parameters.description: Select one published coverage surface by id.

parameters.name: admin_code
parameters.description: Cell filter: administrative area code of the coverage cell.

parameters.name: h3_index
parameters.description: Cell filter: H3 index of the coverage cell.

parameters.name: business_date
parameters.description: Cell filter: business date of the coverage cell.

parameters.name: readiness
parameters.description: Cell filter: readiness of the coverage cell (not the surface envelope readiness).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Cell filter: coverage state of the cell.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of matched cells to return. Values <= 0 mean unbounded.

get.description: Filters select coverage cells, not the surface envelope. `admin_code`, `h3_index`, `business_date`, `readiness` and `state` name CoverageCell fields, so a surface is returned only when at least one of its cells satisfies every supplied filter, and `cells` is narrowed to those matches. A query that matches no cell returns 404 rather than an unfiltered surface. When the response is narrowed by a filter or by `limit`, `metadata.cell_query` reports the applied filters and the published / matched / returned cell counts. Contract aggregates (`state_breakdown`, `freshness`, `search_completeness`) always describe the full published surface, not the returned subset.

ready.description: Whether the BFF can serve backed market intelligence. Omitted for ready health responses.

available.description: Whether the data-platform binding is available. Omitted for ready health responses.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason for an unavailable binding. Present when status is unavailable.

missing.description: Bindings or evidence missing while the BFF is unavailable.

code.description: The binding reason code that caused fail-closed behavior.

ForbiddenError.description: Access forbidden by tenant isolation or RBAC policy

ServiceUnavailableError.description: Market Intelligence BFF is unavailable because its data-platform binding is missing; the response remains fail-closed.
